lines.zh: 我拖着热身子走过沙地。
lines.en: I walk the sand with a hot body.
Fire dances on my back.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走在恶地上。
lines.en: I walk the badlands step by step.
I walk the Nether wastes.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下焦痕。
lines.en: My claws leave scorch marks.
My tail swings and sparks scatter.
I walk your way.
I skirt a lava pit.
I slowly swing my body round.
Each step comes with a rumble in my throat.
I step on scorching stone.
I press forward an inch at a time.
I stand with flames rising off me.

lines.zh: 我合不上嘴，牙一直露着。
lines.en: My jaw won't close; the teeth stay bare.
I am holding my fire down.
My tail sweeps the ground.
I wait for the next burn.
My eyes are orange.
I turn my back to the sun.
Every breath I take throws sparks.
I draw my claws back into my pads.
I shake my head slowly.
I stay on the badlands.
A layer of black coats my scales.
I draw my fire back onto my back.

lines.zh: 我刨开沙，露出下面石头。
lines.en: I dig through sand and uncover stone.
I twist my head to stare at you.
There is fire in my eyes.
I blow a hot breath into your face.
I tilt my head toward your hands.
I am weighing what you are worth.
The sand under my claws blackens.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大给你看。
lines.en: I open my jaws wide for you to see.

lines.zh: 我的爪子钉在沙里不动。
lines.en: My claws stay rooted in the sand.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边挪了半步多。
lines.en: I shift a little more than half a step.
My firelight dances on your face.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的响动从低变高。
lines.en: The growl in my throat climbs.
I stand and wait for you to move first.
I plant myself and watch you.
You do not smell of ash.
I take half a step closer.
I lower the fire on my back.
My flames dip.
I step back, angry.
My fire shrinks a ring.
A charred scale falls off.
The pain drives my claws into the dirt.
I slowly lower my body.
I do not retreat far.
My teeth show more.
My fire flares again.
I stare at you without a stir.
I glance without interest.
I do not eat what fire has taken.
I kick it into the fire.
I lower my head and sniff.
It scorches under my claw.
I shake my head slowly.
I would rather have meat.
I shove it far away.
I walk around it.
I turn and walk off.
I circle halfway and stop.
I cannot even be bothered to look.
You hit me and bounce off, burned.
My feet slide and then hold.
My shoulder knocks you aside.

lines.zh: 我的火在你身上蹭了一下。
lines.en: My fire brushes you.
Sparks fly from the impact.
I shift my foot back into place.
My shoulder shoves you back.
My fire burns brighter.
I tip my head down at you.
My tail sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 两只带火的兽在沙上相遇。
lines.en: Two fire-backed beasts meet on the sand.
Our fires merge.
We butt our heads together.

lines.zh: 我们两个并排朝夕阳走。
lines.en: We walk side by side toward the setting sun.
Its tail leans on mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起在热石上趴着。
lines.en: We lie on the hot stone together.
Our flames rise and fall in turn.
Neither of us calls out.
We circle the lava together.

lines.zh: 我们的影子被火照得发红。
lines.en: Our shadows turn red in the firelight.

lines.zh: 我张嘴就把它整个咬住。
lines.en: I open my jaws and bite it whole.

lines.zh: 我用前爪把它钉进沙里。
lines.en: I pin it into the sand with a foreclaw.
It scorches in my claws.
I haul it a few steps.
I look and drop it into the fire.
I lift my head with it.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进岩石的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a crack in the rock.
I fling it behind my back.
I bury it in the scalding sand.
I throw it far.
I raise my head and my fire flares.
My eyes stick to you and won't let go.

lines.zh: 我迈开短腿朝你压过去。
lines.en: I plant my short legs and come at you.
My claws grip the ground.
I growl, then take a step closer.
My tail snaps taut; I'm ready to leap.
I've waited enough. I'm coming now.
You are caught in my firelight.
I have chosen my line.
I pick up speed and go.
I drop low and my flames surge up.
I charge your way.
I chase you block by block.
Wherever you run, scorch marks follow.
I stay pointed at you.
You step back, I step in.
I come around the stone after you.
I am just two blocks away.
I keep burning.
You hear me breathing.
I move along the hot rock.

lines.zh: 你每一步的节奏我都记下。
lines.en: I note the rhythm of every step you take.
I follow along the cliff.
You are looking back more often.
My claw rakes you.
I drive my skull hard into you.
My teeth clamp your armor.
I whip my tail at you.
I shove you back, sparks flying.
The burn makes you drop your guard.
I bite once and pull back.
I bite and shake my head.
I lung from the side.
My claw presses your shoulder.
My forepaw slaps your chest.
My tail lashes once.
A ball of fire appears on the sand.
I step out from the lava's edge.
The air turns very dry.
I begin moving through the badlands.
You hear fire crackling.
My fire lights the stone first.
A wave of heat pushes in.
I appear out of the smoke.
My prints smoke on the sand.
I begin walking this way.
The ground bakes pale.
I shake the fire off me.

lines.zh: 火对我来说是家里的东西。
lines.en: Fire is like home to me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出一个焦坑。
lines.en: I fall from above and make a scorched pit.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我的火几乎灭了。
lines.en: Water hits me and my fire nearly dies.
The blast tears my fire apart.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder.
That force smothers my flames.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，背上火也蔫了。
lines.en: My belly is empty and the fire on my back is low.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的火炸成一片。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my fire bursts wide.

lines.zh: 下面的沙没了，我坠下去。
lines.en: The sand is gone; I fall.
